## 📋 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
This document details multiple parts and assemblies related to office furniture components, primarily various grommets, casters, trim brackets, wall parts, and connectors used throughout modular office furniture systems. Their purpose is to provide functional finishing components such as wire management, furniture mobility, aesthetics, and structural support. The significance lies in the extensive catalog color options, standardized material and finish specifications, and the detailed replacement and service information critical for manufacturing and field servicing.

## 🔧 PART INFORMATION

- **Part Number**: Multiple parts referenced; examples include 0130217500 (Grommets), 3190051700 (Locking Caster), 4500663500 (Multisurface Caster), 0000714100/0000714200 (Wire Guide Cover), 0500168000 (Tube Cap), 0200286100 (Hutch Grommets), 4500046400/4500046800 (Clarity Screw).  
- **Part Name/Description**: Examples include Plastic Part Color per Catalog Option, Allsteel Grommet Option Class, Locking Caster, 60mm Caster Assembly, Glide Adaptor/Arm Cap, Concensys Endtrim Topcap Bracket, Beyond Zipper/Connector, Wall Parts, Acoustic Glass Door Parts, Wire Guide Cover, Hardwire Leg Assembly, Tube Cap, Hutch Grommets, Screw.  
- **Revision**: FORMAL BF. (Formal revision, e.g., dated 17-OCT-2025 with note “Switched bumper color selection from gray to black on sheet 16”)  
- **Release State**: FORMAL BF or FORMAL (implied from content)  
- **Sheet Info**: Sheets 1 to 25 of 25 (e.g., SHEET 1 OF 25, SHEET 22 OF 25, etc.)  
- **Material**: Various polymers such as SIM-080 HIGH IMPACT POLYSTYRENE, ABS, LUSTRAN 433 ABS, unspecified materials referenced by BOM or notes.  
- **Finish**: See specification E9-0206 for most parts; some indicate finishes like Platinum Flat, Titanium, Black, Designer White, and others per catalog option codes.  
- **Replaceable**: Majority marked Y (YES) indicating field replaceable; some explicitly marked N (NO) such as Locking Caster (Page 5) and some connectors; R (Restricted) occasionally referenced.  
- **Document Type**: Predominantly Assembly and Detail drawings for parts and subassemblies, with specification references.

## 📦 BILL OF MATERIALS (BOM) SUMMARY

- **Total Components**: Numerous unique items identified—over 30+ distinct part numbers and assemblies across categories like grommets, casters, wall parts, connector parts, and screws.  
- **Key Sub-Assemblies**:  
  - Grommet assemblies (Hutch Grommets, Support Leg Grommets, Worksurface Grommets)  
  - Casters (Multisurface Caster variants, Locking Casters)  
  - Glide Adaptors and Arm Caps  
  - Concensys Endtrim and Transition Parts  
  - Wire Guide Covers  
  - Hardwire Leg Assemblies  
  - Tube Caps  
  - Beyond Zipper/Connector assemblies  
- **Critical Parts**:  
  - Color and finish critical components with detailed color codes for coordination between structure and surfaces.  
  - Structural components such as Locking Casters and Hardwire Leg Assemblies for safety and system integrity.  
  - Wire Guide Covers and Grommets important for cable management and aesthetic finishing.  
- **Hardware/Fasteners**: Screws (part # 4500046400, 4500046800 - Clarity Screw) listed as replaceable parts; connectors and cap assemblies also include fasteners though details mainly catalog-coded.

## 🔩 ASSEMBLY CONTEXT

- The parts fit within modular office furniture systems as finishing components for wire management, mobility, aesthetic caps, and structural connectors.  
- Assembly sequence usually places grommets in worksurfaces or panels to allow cable routing, casters attach to furniture legs/bases to provide mobility, and trim brackets or connectors secure joined furniture components.  
- Mating parts include worksurfaces, legs, panel assemblies, frames, and glass sliding door components (for acoustic doors).  
- Service/replaceability: Most components labeled “Y” indicating they are field replaceable, facilitating maintenance and color/finish updates. Some critical components (Locking Casters, certain connectors) are non-serviceable, indicating replacement of entire units required.  
- Assemblies may have mating tolerances and finishes to ensure proper fit and color matching, with structured catalog options to maintain consistency.

## 📝 NOTES & SPECIFICATIONS

- **General Notes**:  
  - Catalog options differentiate between HON core colors and other special Allsteel finishes; refer to MDS 10277/10282 for active finish lists.  
  - Do not scale drawings.  
  - Third angle projection applies throughout documentation.  
- **Dimensional Tolerances**:  
  - Typical tolerances for dimensions in inches: ±0.03 or tighter ±0.01 or ±0.005 as specified; metric dimensions similarly specified with ±0.015 or ±0.0001.  
  - Critical dimensions or angles noted with more stringent angle tolerances ±0.5 or ±1.0 degrees.  
- **Material Specifications**:  
  - Polymers: SIM-080 High Impact Polystyrene, ABS, LUSTRAN 433 ABS, among others explained in BOM or notes.  
  - Metals and finishes referenced by catalog color codes such as titanium, platinum, anodized finishes, metallic paint options.  
- **Manufacturing Notes**:  
  - Color finish coordination between structural parts (suffixes and codes) is critical.  
  - Plastic and metal grommets have specific finish and color matching per catalog options.  
  - Attention to dimensional accuracy and finish quality mandated by tolerance and finish specifications.  
- **Quality/Testing**:  
  - Strict confidentiality and proprietary handling of information indicated.  
  - Revision records show process controls and change management (e.g., color selection update).  
  - Drawings indicated as “DO NOT SCALE” emphasizes precision and manufacturing control.

## 🏷️ SEMANTIC TAGS

- Furniture Type: Office furniture, worksurface, panel, wall system  
- Component Category: Grommet, caster, wire guide, cap, connector, fastener (screw)  
- Assembly Level: Component, sub-assembly, final assembly  
- Manufacturing Complexity: Moderate (multiple catalog options and tight tolerances)  
- Service Relevance: Field replaceable (majority), restricted/non-serviceable (select parts)  
- Material Category: Plastic (ABS, Polystyrene), Metal (aluminum, steel finishes), Composite finishes  
- Color/Finish Coordination: Catalog color options, proprietary finishes  
- Application Context: Cable management, mobility, aesthetic trim, structural connection  
- Documentation: Engineering print, proprietary & confidential  
- Quality Compliance: Dimensional control, finish standard adherence

## 💼 BUSINESS CONTEXT

- **Service Part?** Yes, the majority of parts including grommets, casters, wire guides, adaptors, and screws are designed to be field replaceable, facilitating maintenance and upgrades. Some connectors and locking casters are non-serviceable, requiring full assembly replacements.  
- **Business Processes**:  
  - Manufacturing relies on detailed catalog color and material specs for production consistency.  
  - Service teams use replaceability data for efficient field repairs and part swaps.  
  - Sales utilize catalog option codes to configure customer orders per product specifications.  
  - Engineering manages revisions, tolerances, and compliance to maintain quality and update components as needed.  
- **Critical for**:  
  - Safety (locking casters, structural assemblies).  
  - Compliance with dimensional tolerances and finish standards to ensure correct assembly and customer satisfaction.  
  - Quality and aesthetic consistency for product robustness and marketability.  
  - Cost control through standardized parts and replaceability.  
- **Complexity Implications**:  
  - Moderate complexity with extensive catalog color options demanding flexible manufacturing tooling and inventory management.  
  - Tight dimensional tolerances necessitate precise tooling and quality assurance processes.  
  - Coordination between polymer molding, metal finishing, and assembly requires integrated supply chain and manufacturing control.
